pr_title: adds support for aligned crop in search result
pr_body:
Adds support for word aligned crops in search result.

fixes #478
pr_comments: By the way, did you changed the documentation accordingly?

issue_context.title: Crop improvements
issue_context.body: Currently, the crop can cut in the middle of a word. It would be better if the crop was done at the beginning/end of the word. Ex: crop of 20 (chars) ``` Hello guys! MeiliSearch is the best search engine I've ever tried. See you soon! ``` is currently cropped this way: ``` o guys! MeiliSearch is the best search e ``` But, it could be cropped this way (=removing the cropped words): ``` guys! MeiliSearch is the best search ``` or this way (=keeping the cropped words): ``` Hello guys! MeiliSearch is the best search engine ``` Suggestion: the `cropLength` could be a number of words instead of a number of characters. ### Version v8.4.0

review_comments: After that I'll approve and merge :)
